This vintage Sheaffer writing instrument set features a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil adorned with an intricate chased floral scroll and grapevine motif. Detailed all-over grapevine and scrolling acanthus leaf pattern with polished accents
Classic Sheaffer White Dot pocket clips with spring mechanism
Each writing instrument measures approximately 5 inches in length
Includes hardshell Reflections Fine Writing Instruments display box

Very good vintage condition with gentle surface wear consistent with age and light handling. Metal surfaces retain warm, even gold luster throughout the ornate chased detailing. Mechanical pencil and ballpoint components present intact. Pencil marked SHEAFFER U.S.A. and 12K G.F. with crown mark; pen marked SHEAFFER U.S.A. and 12K R.G.P. CASING with crown mark. Tested gold plated. Presentation case shows minor vintage shelf wear.
Warehouse Location: Canton
